title: NestJS GraphQL API — pre-built schematic
about: Head-to-head backend build: both arms implement full GraphQL CRUD endpoints (entity, DTOs, repository, service, resolver, tests, Bruno collection) for the same 14 entities in one full sweep. The with-schematics arm ships a pre-built Project Builder generator — the AI only writes the Mongoose schema and runs it; the without arm hand-writes every layer following the same conventions.
proves: Whether a deterministic generator that ALREADY exists makes the same task cheaper, faster and more consistent than pure AI — at equal spec compliance and with the same definition of done (tsc, lint, unit and e2e tests all green).
